questions.question: Sami calls Mina: 'A 12-year-old patient with a severe Class II! What should we do?' Mina replies:
options: Wait for the end of growth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'At 12 years old, a functional appliance can stimulate mandibular growth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will prescribe an activator.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage an impacted canine at stage 5?' Mina replies:
options: Create space then perform orthodontic traction
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'At Nolla stage 5, the canine is erupting. Traction is indicated.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will create space and perform traction.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of functional appliances?' Mina replies:
options: They use growth to correct malocclusions
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Functional appliances use growth to correct malocclusions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use activators in children.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage an anterior open bite in an adult?' Mina replies:
options: Mini-screws for molar intrusion or orthognathic surgery
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Open bite in adults can be treated with mini-screws or surgery.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose mini-screws for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is molar distalization?' Mina replies:
options: Moving molars backward to correct Class II
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Molar distalization is a technique to correct Class II.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use mini-screws to distalize.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When should orthognathic surgery be considered?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthognathic surgery is indicated for severe skeletal malocclusions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer patients to surgeons.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a face mask in orthodontics?' Mina replies:
options: An appliance to treat Class III in children
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The face mask is used to correct Class III in children.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose a face mask for this young patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a post-orthodontic relapse?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Relapse can be treated with orthodontic re-treatment.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose re-treatment to this patient.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is distraction osteogenesis?' Mina replies:
options: A technique to gradually lengthen bone
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Distraction osteogenesis is a technique to correct mandibular asymmetries.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer patients to surgeons.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a Class III in an 8-year-old child?' Mina replies:
options: Face mask or maxillary expansion appliance
Wait for the end of growth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Class III in children is often treated with a face mask.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose a face mask.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the Tweed method in orthodontics?' Mina replies:
options: A cephalometric analysis of dental inclinations
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Tweed's analysis evaluates dental inclinations and treatment objectives.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use Tweed's analysis.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a severe facial asymmetry?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Severe asymmetries require a combined orthodontic-surgery approach.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will plan a multidisciplinary approach.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the Steiner method in orthodontics?' Mina replies:
options: A cephalometric analysis of skeletal and dental relationships
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Steiner's analysis evaluates skeletal and dental relationships.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use Steiner's analysis.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient with TMD (temporomandibular joint dysfunction) and malocclusion?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'TMD often requires a splint before orthodontic treatment.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will first stabilize the TMJ.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of mini-screws in orthodontics?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mini-screws offer absolute anchorage without depending on the patient.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use mini-screws for anchorage.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a severe canine rotation?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Severe rotations can be corrected with springs.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will derotate this canine.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is stripping in orthodontics?' Mina replies:
options: A technique of interproximal enamel reduction
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Stripping is a technique to create space by reducing enamel.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use stripping for crowding.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage agenesis of lateral incisors?' Mina replies:
options: Space closure or preservation for implant
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The strategy depends on the occlusion and the dentition.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will plan the management of agenesis.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the risks of aligners?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Aligners can cause hygiene problems and relapses.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will monitor my patients' hygiene.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a Class II division 2?' Mina replies:
options: Unlock the upper incisors then treat the Class II
Start directly with the Class II
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The retroclined incisors must first be unlocked.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will unlock the incisors first.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a maxillary disjunctor?' Mina replies:
options: A rapid expansion appliance to widen the maxilla
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The disjunctor is used for rapid maxillary expansion.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use a disjunctor for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage severe crowding in an adult?' Mina replies:
options: Extractions or stripping according to Bolton analysis
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The choice depends on Bolton analysis.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will calculate the Bolton before deciding.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of orthognathic surgery?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthognathic surgery corrects severe skeletal malocclusions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer patients to surgeons.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage periodontitis in an orthodontic patient?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthodontic treatment is possible with light forces and strict monitoring.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will adapt the forces for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami, after having tackled complex orthodontic cases with Mina, says: 'I am proud of our successes!' Mina concludes: 'Orthodontic therapies are...'
options: The key to restoring facial balance
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthodontic therapies are the key to restoring facial balance.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to improve.'
